answer: Require each identity to post a bond that grows like a cedar: deep roots over time, not a quick purchase. Newcomers start with tiny, rate-limited rights and earn standing only through a vine of mutual attestations from established agents who stake their own bonds on the newcomer. A canyon between cheap creation and real standing forms because a farm must either wait out the slow growth or risk slashing its sponsors' bonds when a fake is caught, making mass fakery cost more than honest participation.
